name: Yanagibashi Ayami
source:
A highly proud lady who has won plenty of things in her life. She is the daughter of a company's president, but her father's company has only been active for a short time, and is on the lower-rung of the wealthy.
Due to this, she became highly competitive and always tries to assert her authority over anyone she can to deserve her position.
She works hard to overcome her weakness, but she doesn't want others to see her as weak, and is reluctant to let others see her hard-work.
Despite have a reasonably good body, she is insecure since compared to the other bustier girls, she has the smallest bust.
